text:
maria: Quick sync 0: pushed the split/join prototype with commit message semantics. Need thoughts on idempotency and audit footprint.

aaron: skimmed. main concern: duplicate finalizes if joiner retries. CAS on canonical_credit_id plus origin_instance should handle it.

sophie: agree. also: keep token diffs out of hot table, store compact fingerprint + raw_uri in S3.

linus: what about splitters that change expected_count on retry? joiner should support commit control and a grace timeout. mark partial if timed out.

maria: plan: splitter emits (trace_id, split_uuid, idx, best_effort_total). commit msg finalizes early. otherwise finalize after window and flag reason=timeout. audit row includes fingerprints[] and raw_uri.

aaron: provisional vs finalized: provisional visible in dashboards but not invoiced. emit adjustment deltas on finalize.

sophie: tests: duplicate chunk replay, commit-before-chunks, cross-host ordering, large multi-host split. I'll add to the matrix.

ops-bot: ticket created JNR-130 add metrics: joiner.finalize_ms and joiner.partial_rate.

maria: thanks 1! I'll update the PR with commit_nonce, origin_instance, and the finalized audit schema. Please review when I push.
